faqs.question: Will the cholesterol in eggs increase my risk of heart disease?
faqs.answer: Extensive randomized controlled trials demonstrate that dietary cholesterol has minimal impact on serum LDL-C in 70%+ of individuals. This guide details the exact hepatic feedback mechanism.

faqs.question: Do I have to eliminate all fruit and carbohydrates?
faqs.answer: No. The guide highlights the critical difference between cellular fruit sugars bound in fibrous plant cells vs acellular refined sugars in processed foods.

faqs.question: Is this suitable for pre-diabetics?
faqs.answer: Yes, the visual diagrams make insulin sensitivity and postprandial glucose regulation extraordinarily easy to understand.

The SCFA powerhouse: how butyrate fuels colonocytes and tight junctions
Gentle titration protocol: how to increase fiber without gas or bloating

what_is_included.description: 5-gram stepwise increments, hydration pairings, and low-FODMAP swaps.

faqs.question: Why do high-fiber foods sometimes make me bloated?
faqs.answer: When fiber-starved gut bacteria suddenly receive large amounts of prebiotic oligosaccharides, rapid fermentation creates gas. The guide provides a gentle titration strategy to prevent this completely.

faqs.question: How much fiber do I actually need?
faqs.answer: The evolutionary ancestral estimate is 40-100g/day, while the modern Western average is only 15g. We help you target a realistic 30-38g/day.
